test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Who among the following political leaders became Member of Parliament from Sangrur constituency, Punjab in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Simranjit Singh Mann**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Simranjit Singh Mann:-**

 
 
• **He is a former Indian Police Service officer who has been a vocal advocate for Sikh rights.**
 
• He is also the president of the Shiromani Akali Dal (Amritsar), a political party that advocates for the creation of an independent Sikh state called Khalistan.
 
• **Simranjit Singh Mann became the Member of Parliament from Sangrur constituency, Punjab in June 2022. **
 
• He won the Sangrur Lok Sabha by-election on a Shiromani Akali Dal (Amritsar) ticket, defeating the Aam Aadmi Party candidate Gurmail Singh by 5,822 votes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Arvind Kejriwal:-**

 
 
• **He is an Indian politician, activist, and former bureaucrat who is serving as the 7th and current Chief Minister of Delhi since 2015 and from 2013 to 2014. **
 
• He is also the national convener of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) since 2012. He represents New Delhi constituency in the Delhi Legislative Assembly since 2015 and from 2013 to 2014.
 
 
 
• **Azam Khan:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian politician who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) from Rampur Lok Sabha constituency since 2019. **
 
• He is a member of the Samajwadi Party (SP) and has been a member of the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Assembly (MLA) for seven terms, representing Rampur Sadar constituency from 1980 to 2019.
 
 
 
• **Bhagwant Mann:-**
 
 
• **He is an Indian politician who has been serving as the 17th Chief Minister of Punjab since 2022. **
 
• He is a member of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP).
